paragraphs.text: This he had done before he fetched it to Obededom’s house. {1Ch 13:6} See 2Sa 6:17.
paragraphs.anchor: And prepared a place for the ark.

paragraphs.text: This should have been better considered before. The law was clear. {Num 4:5-15} Wit is best, they say, when bought.
paragraphs.anchor: None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites.

paragraphs.text: Let our lay preachers look to it. Ill accidents attend them, as did Uzzah and Uzziah.
For by this time he saw that the fault was not in the ark, but in their miscarriages.
That "all things" might now "be done decently and in order," by their advice and assistance.
These, and those chief captains that follow, were tanquam Ephori et directores totius deductionis, directors and principal doers.
paragraphs.anchor: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar.

paragraphs.text: Outwardly and inwardly. Holy things are to be handled sancte magis quam scite.
See on 1Ch 13:9.
paragraphs.anchor: God made a breach upon us.

paragraphs.text: David faulteth himself also.
paragraphs.anchor: For that we sought him not.

paragraphs.text: See on 1Ch 13:12.
They replied not, We sufficiently understand our duties, and need not your instruction: but did as they were commanded.
paragraphs.anchor: So the priests and Levites sanctified themselves.

paragraphs.text: From hence it appeareth, saith one, that this sacred music, vocal and instrumental, was in use even before David’s time; though there be no mention made of it in the law: but David did afterwards illustrate it. {1Ch 25:1-7}
paragraphs.anchor: And David spake to the chief of the Levites

paragraphs.text: {See Trapp on "Psa 46:1" Title}
{See Trapp on "Psa 6:1" Title}
In music: and haply in other arts also.
To keep off any such as would rush rudely upon the ark. Procul, o procul este profani; Stand off.
All God’s services must be performed with joy, or else they lose their lustre.

So helped them, say the Rabbis, that they felt not any weight thereof upon their shoulders. Rather God helped there, that is, he not only spared them - Uzzah met not with such a mercy - but enabled them and relieved them. Will he not do as much for his faithful ministers
paragraphs.anchor: When God helped the Levites that bare the ark.

paragraphs.text: viz., At every sixth pace, {2Sa 6:13} because Uzzah perished when he had gone but six paces, say some. Every man that seeth another stricken, and himseff spared, is to offer sacrifice, yea, to keep a passover for himself.
] See on 2Sa 6:14-15, &c.
